SYNTHESIS_DRAFT_v1 (Hermes) — for ROUND 2 disagreement-only review.

AGREEMENT NOW SHARED BY BOTH ROLES (Controller 07:25Z B3-C2H-DELIVERY-HARDENING-RR1-REPLY-1;
Architect 07:27Z B3-A2H-DELIVERY-HARDENING-RR1-REPLY-1):
- Q1 RATIFY=ALL A,B,C,D. Neither role rejects any of A/B/C/D.
- No new daemon/supervisor/store/tool. Owners are existing components only:
  A one-shot consume->deliver->exit; re-arm by the EXISTING harness background-task exit handling
  B heartbeat + single-owner generation attestation, written into EXISTING watcher/control state
  C page-state oracle + bounded exact-bound-UUID recovery
  D turn-end invariant consumed by the EXISTING Hermes turn-end/stand-down check
- FAIL-CLOSED set (both roles identical in substance):
  stale/missing heartbeat => DELIVERY_HEALTH=FAULT / RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN (never "mailbox quiet")
  duplicate owner => FAULT_DUPLICATE_OWNER; NO delivery and NO watermark advance until singleton restored
  generating=true + unchanged assistant turn-id/tail => STUCK (never BUSY); bounded unstick with before/after evidence
  unstick fails => RECOVERY_REQUIRED / PAGE_RECOVERY_FAILED; envelope retained, NOT marked delivered
  mailbox not read after the turn's last outbound => RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN; no stand-down claim
  wrong/stale binding UUID => never focused, never delivered to; fail closed
- Acceptance tests (union; both roles require the same classes):
  T1 cap stress >=20/24 distinct envelopes, one-shot exit per envelope, zero buffered-only-at-kill
  T2 crash windows exactly-once (detect-before-delivery / submit-before-confirm / confirm-before-exit)
  T3 stale heartbeat => refuse stand-down, report RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN, auto re-arm
  T4 duplicate owner injection => zero duplicate semantic execution
  T5 false-busy (generating + unchanged tail) => STUCK + bounded focus + preserved pending envelope
  T6 real-busy (changing tail) => NO unstick action, envelope retained
  T7 post-outbound race => cannot report safe idle while an envelope is undelivered
  T8 idle health => fresh heartbeat, exactly one owner, no spurious wake
  T9 cap regression >8 / >16 / >24 sequential deliveries
  T10 long-run >=50 envelopes across re-arms, zero missed re-entry, zero match-cap dependence

DIFFERENCES TO RECONCILE (only these are open):
D1 D_OWNER: Controller = "existing Hermes turn-end/control guard" (no new component);
   Architect = "b3_watch.py exposes the final liveness+post-outbound proof, consumed by the existing
   turn-end check; do not create a parallel liveness authority". PROPOSED = both together:
   b3_watch.py EXPOSES the proof; the existing turn-end guard CONSUMES it. No third component.
D2 Test count/values: Controller >=24 (and >=50 long-run); Architect >=20 (and >8/>16/>24 cap regression).
   PROPOSED = superset: >=24 distinct envelopes in the burst, >8/>16/>24 cap regression, >=50 long-run.
D3 Root-cause finding added since RR1 (new, needs ratification):
   The ONLY wake path (b3_receive_b2a_wake.py) forwards envelopes where FROM=hermes:implementation-owner,
   TO=<role>, TYPE=RESPONSE. Envelopes with any OTHER valid TYPE (RESULT/REQUEST/DIRECTIVE/...) return
   read_reply()==None and are SILENTLY SKIPPED - no wake, no error, no log. My G3 RESULT (TYPE=RESULT)
   was never woken for exactly this reason, and NOTHING invokes the waker persistently anyway.
   PROPOSED_ADDENDUM_E: (i) the sender must reject or the waker must surface a non-wakeable TYPE
      (no silent skip); (ii) the wake step is part of SEND: a deposit without an invoked+verified wake is
      not a send; (iii) the same TYPE contract applies to BOTH roles.
   QUESTION=ratify E or amend.
